test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'LECTURE' is written as 'MGFXZXL' and 'TEACHER' is written as 'UGDGMKY'. How will 'STUDENT' be written in that language?
solution:
Table of alphabets place values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern follows here,

'LECTURE' is written as 'MGFXZXL' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb3523dcbbc61e3b110674fc3d88c8e154276f1865360160d2508b3ca23a2763.png] 

And,

'TEACHER' is written as 'UGDGMKY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcf80c1e5c75b068884560121837f42c26639499ab0cb0f5d9b82f27fc5ff627.png] 

Similarly,

'STUDENT' be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56f714d5d9a2aac90143c0a0dc8851e5e7207db050e6891a1a2da08d1377fe24.png] 

Hence, 'STUDENT' is coded as '**TVXHJTA**'
